129:t_1:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「...So $$サイデリアル$$ is about to begin an invasion of Japan, as we feared.」

129:t_1:5.en:
$$大塚$$
「The $$極東支部$$ has committed much of its strength to defending 《$$新日本$$》, so gaps in our defenses are unavoidable.」

129:t_1:6.en:
$$大塚$$
「The Empire is exploiting those gaps. Its reconnaissance forces have appeared repeatedly since you were transported into space.」

129:t_1:7.en:
$$レイアム$$
「What are Japan's special-unit forces doing?」

129:t_1:8.en:
$$大塚$$
「The $$クラッシャー隊$$ is on another mission in space. It will take time for them to return.」

129:t_1:9.en:
$$大塚$$
「$$２１世紀警備保障$$ is also rescuing refugees in Central Asia, which is under the Empire's control.」

129:t_1:10.en:
$$オットー$$
「Since we can't call them back, we have no choice but to defend Japan ourselves.」

129:t_1:11.en:
$$大塚$$
「While the continents are engulfed in war, Japan has managed to stay relatively peaceful.」

129:t_1:12.en:
$$大塚$$
「So we expect it to serve as the center of our coming counteroffensive against the Empire.」

129:t_1:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ must understand that too. That's why it's targeting Japan.」

129:t_1:14.en:
$$大塚$$
「We're overwhelmed just dealing with the immediate situation. We still haven't even been able to investigate the former $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ site.」

129:t_1:15.en:
$$大塚$$
「I'm sorry, but I need you all to come to Japan as quickly as possible.」

129:t_1:16.en:
$$オットー$$
「I understand, Director $$大塚$$. The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ will descend to Earth and head directly for the former $$第３新東京市$$.」

129:t_1:22.en:
$n
「Are you worried about $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s movements?」

129:t_1:23.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'll leave that to $$刹那$$ and the others. Right now, I'm worried about Japan.」

129:t_1:24.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Your school is there too, after all.」

129:t_1:26.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...I haven't talked about this much, but until a little while ago, I was a high school student too.」

129:t_1:27.en:
$n
「I heard you were in a guerrilla organization called the $$エゥーゴ$$...」

129:t_1:29.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Sometimes I wonder... What would have happened to me if I'd stayed a student instead of getting into a $$ガンダム$$ back then...?」

129:t_1:30.en:
$n
「Do you want to go back to those days?」

129:t_1:31.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...That's not what I mean. My memories aren't all good ones.」

129:t_1:32.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But... There were things I treasured there too.」

129:t_1:34.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's why I don't want to see people living those lives have their everyday world taken away for no reason.」

129:t_1:36.en:
$n
「That's why I fight... I have the power to do that now.」

129:t_1:37.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're like $$セツコ$$ in that way.」

129:t_1:39.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「She used to be one of our comrades... And she's the $$悲しみの乙女$$ $$スフィア・リアクター$$.」

129:t_1:40.en:
$n
「So she's one of the three $$リアクター$$s who were in $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$...」

129:t_1:41.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$シン$$ and I have known her since the $$多元戦争$$ in $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

129:t_1:42.en:
$n
「He told me a little about her. He said she's strong enough not to give in to sorrow.」

129:t_1:43.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's right. That's what I thought you had in common with her.」

129:t_1:44.en:
$n
「...I'm not that admirable. I was only fighting to vent my anger and escape my fear.」

129:t_1:45.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I told you before, didn't I? I started fighting for personal reasons too.」

129:t_1:46.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「In the end, not much has changed. I still fight because of my own feelings and convictions.」

129:t_1:48.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We don't need anyone's praise or respect. But if we think our fighting can change something, let's do it.」

129:t_1:50.en:
$n
「...Wait, you... knew I still hadn't gotten over what happened with $$シンジ$$, so you...」

129:t_1:51.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$アルト$$ and $$宗介$$ aren't here now. I'm not trying to take their place, but I thought I'd meddle a little.」

129:t_1:53.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We help each other with things like this. $$シン$$ helped me when it came to the Colonel too.」

129:t_1:54.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So if you see someone in trouble, help them out too.」

129:t_1:55.en:
$n
「Yeah... That's what I intend to do.」

129:t_1:56.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「In your case, maybe the first thing is to stop causing trouble for Miss $$スズネ$$.」

129:t_1:58.en:
$n
「This is a good chance, so tell me. How can I become an equal partner to Miss $$スズネ$$?」

129:t_1:59.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Even if you ask me that, I don't know...」

129:t_1:60.en:
$n
「You just said I should help out a comrade in trouble!」

129:t_1:61.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「N-Now I'm the one in trouble...」

129:t_1:62.en:
$n
「Please, $$カミーユ$$! All I got from $$アルト$$ and $$甲児$$ were answers that missed the point!」

129:t_1:63.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What did they tell you?」

129:t_1:64.en:
$n
「They said to buy her flowers on anniversaries, compliment her when she changes her hair, or pat her head when she's sad...」

129:t_1:65.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...They gave you some irresponsible advice...」

129:t_1:66.en:
$n
「Captain $$クラン$$ somehow ended up lecturing me for two hours, and I still don't understand how it happened.」

129:t_1:67.en:
$n
「When I complained to $$千鳥$$ about that, somehow she ended up lecturing me for three hours. I didn't understand that either.」

129:t_1:69.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Have you talked to $$宗介$$ about this?」

129:t_1:70.en:
$n
「...Do you want to hear his answer?」

129:t_1:72.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What's going on, $n and $$カミーユ$$? You seem to be having quite a conversation.」

129:t_1:75.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I-I'm sorry...! There are things you wouldn't want a woman to overhear.」

129:t_1:77.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You are at that age, after all. I suppose it can't be helped...」

129:t_1:78.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But, $$カミーユ$$... Don't do anything that would make $$ファ$$ or $$フォウ$$ sad.」

129:t_1:80.en:
$$スズネ$$
「We'll be descending to Earth soon, so start getting ready.」

129:t_1:81.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Wait a moment, Miss $$スズネ$$! I...」

129:t_1:82.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Ah... It's all right, $$カミーユ$$. I won't tell Lieutenant $$エマ$$ or Captain $$アムロ$$.」

129:t_1:84.en:
$n
「Give it up, $$カミーユ$$. Once Miss $$スズネ$$ gets an idea into her head, she doesn't change it easily.」

129:t_1:85.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So you want to be an equal partner to her...」
